title: Vorbemerkung
author: Walther von Dyck
full_title: Nova Kepleriana: Wieder aufgefundene Drucke und Handschriften von Johannes Kepler, 4: Die Keplerbriefe auf der Nationalbibliothek und auf der Sternwarte in Paris
source: Walther von Dyck's preface to *Nova Kepleriana* 4: *Die Keplerbriefe auf der Nationalbibliothek und auf der Sternwarte in Paris*, ed. Walther von Dyck and Max Caspar, Abhandlungen der Bayerischen Akademie der Wissenschaften, Math.-naturw. Abteilung 31, no. 1 (Munich, 1927), 3–4. Von Dyck (1856–1934), professor of mathematics at the Technische Hochschule in Munich, had found the letters in Paris at Easter 1914; the volume was presented to the Academy on 15 May 1926.
transcribed_from: the page images of the 1927 printing.
summary: Von Dyck explains how he found these letters of Kepler, Bartsch and Crüger in Paris at Easter 1914, why the edition was delayed by the war, and that Max Caspar shared the translation and notes; he calls for a complete edition of Kepler's correspondence.

notes.on: a complete edition of the correspondence
notes.note: It came: Kepler's letters fill volumes 13–18 of the *Gesammelte Werke*, begun in 1937 by Caspar and von Dyck.
Bernhard Bischoff (1906–1991), later the leading palaeographer of his day.
